overall_comment: This case presents conflicting imaging features. The T2-FLAIR mismatch sign strongly suggests an IDH-mutant astrocytoma. However, the deep midline location and sharp transition zone are more typical for an IDH-wildtype glioma. Weighing the high specificity of the T2-FLAIR mismatch sign, the prediction is for an IDH-mutant astrocytoma. The presence of necrosis, contrast enhancement, and significant mass effect are compelling evidence for high-grade disease, leading to a CNS WHO grade 4 prediction.
